scope: Repository-local evidence only; external pk_core defaults are not treated as implementation proof.

consolidated_missing_components.why: The reference model changes Python objects only; it does not issue microsecond-scale vCPU/core reassignment to a real runtime/hypervisor.

consolidated_missing_components.component: Bundled/pinned pk_core dependency or install manifest
consolidated_missing_components.why: The archive does not include pk_core and has no pyproject/requirements lock describing a compatible version; full adapter tests skip.
SCHEMAS.md documents Python mappings, but no JSON Schema/WIT/protobuf/OpenAPI or generated validators exist.
No actor/node identity, capability, least-privilege or authorization enforcement exists.
No versioned config schema, activation transaction, provenance, overlays, rollback package or secret-handling policy exists.

consolidated_missing_components.component: Durable state/audit persistence and external anchoring
consolidated_missing_components.why: The hash chain is in-memory only; restart reconstruction, durable audit storage, timestamps, signing/attestation, rotation and export are absent.
Local replay/stale-record protection does not implement leases, epochs, split-brain protection or duplicate-owner fencing across controllers.

consolidated_missing_components.component: Health, stall detection, quarantine and emergency controls
consolidated_missing_components.why: No watchdog thresholds, readiness endpoint, quarantine/freeze state or production kill switch exists.
Operation idempotency exists, but there is no retry policy, jitter, timeout/cancellation, queue/backpressure model, circuit breaker or overload shedding.
Network/site/provider/dependency/control-plane failures, failover and reconnect semantics are not implemented or documented.
No latency/throughput/startup/resource/power baselines, percentile targets, load profiles, density model or regression gate exists.

consolidated_missing_components.component: Metrics, logging, tracing, explainability, dashboards and alerts
consolidated_missing_components.why: Contract signal names and structured audit events are not an observability implementation; exporters, traces, redaction policy, explain view, lineage correlation and alerting are absent.
A short threat list and several hostile-input tests exist, but no full threat model, trust-service outage rules, artifact verification, encryption/key lifecycle or full adversarial suite exists.
Only local unit/concurrency tests exist in this archive; adjacent-layer, cross-runtime, fuzz, fault-injection and disaster suites are absent.
There is no requirement-to-code/test/evidence traceability matrix and no machine-readable release acceptance result bundled with the component.

consolidated_missing_components.component: Ownership, ADR and production governance set
consolidated_missing_components.why: No accountable owner/escalation, approved ADR, incident process, review cadence, exception register, vulnerability/EOL SLA or full release governance package exists.
The package has a version and limited v1 rollback compatibility, but no supported version matrix, negotiation policy or dependency compatibility certification.
Per-guest floors/ceilings do not define tenant quotas, fairness under contention or floor-change authorization.
README bullets are a baseline, not operational procedures with prerequisites, checks, commands, containment, escalation and recovery.
No LICENSE, pyproject/build metadata, dependency lock/SBOM, CI workflow, static-analysis configuration, coverage gate, signed release manifest or provenance attestation is included.
